profile.summary:
***Automation and Custom Solutions***

I am a Solutions Architect and Developer focused on custom automation and easy-to-use interfaces. I design and code solutions that connect systems, simplify workflows, and deliver clear business value. My background spans independent consulting and enterprise environments, with a proven ability to create solutions not available off the shelf.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Animal Health Tracking System Rewrite

Replaced legacy system with a modern Angular SPA and C# REST APIs, improving usability and performance.
Migrated data from SQL Server 2016 to 2025 with engineered scripts, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
Optimized queries and stored procedures, reducing response times and boosting application speed.
Enhanced search with SQL fuzzy logic, making data retrieval faster and more accurate.
Created mobile-friendly UI with Angular v20, Material UI, and Tailwind.css, improving accessibility across devices.

Modern & Legacy Support

Built FDA interfaces using SOAP for secure data exchange.
Created REST API and UI for business lookups in FDA's database.
Designed online form for LP Gas Meter Seal notifications, improving public accessibility.

positions.title: Owner and Tech Guru
positions.description:
https://TOPSConsulting.US - Bringing the BEST to small and midsized companies since 2008.

My experience comes from over 30 years in the industries of Banking, Insurance, Real Estate and ISO Certified Manufacturing. From spreadsheets to websites or more complex applications, I can help you to make that next step with confidence. Let's talk to discuss how I can benefit your organization.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Located in Durham NC, zBest Data Technologies, LLC began as a technology provider to the Real Estate Industry in 2005. What started as a syndication service, has since evolved to include the industries of Manufacturing and Defense, with a host of other products and services that includes:

- Data driven websites for industries such as Real Estate and Online Stores
- Internal and External Web based applications
- Process Automation
- SQL Database Development and Support
- Data Integrations with other systems such as your ERP
- Azure Hosting and Solutions
- Solutions in .Net Core, MVC.Net, ASP.Net, C#
- Simplifying processes and workflows
- Office 365 Solutions
- SharePoint Solutions

In general, I work with technologies compatible to the Microsoft Stack. A summary of them include:

.Net Technologies: C#, MVC, .Net Core, ASP.Net
Database: Development, Optimization and Management of all versions of SQL Server, including Stored Procs, Functions and other higher DB functions.
All Data Formats such as XML, JSON and CSV
Web: Bootstrap, jQuery, HTML5, Angular js, API development, Basic SEO, JavaScript and other common frameworks
Azure Cloud Services including Hosting, Database, and Data Processing

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Delivered automation solutions for healthcare, real estate, and finance clients.
Maintained and converted feeds for RENT.com/REDFIN, enabling customer marketing via website.
Supported healthcare platform simplifying complex medical information into actionable insights.
Built modern corporate site for GF Health Products with Umbraco CMS, integrated with internal systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
CampusParc Website and Vehicle Management System

Introduced QR code access for gates and lots, streamlining security.

positions.description:
Curbside Laundries

Upgraded business platforms to improve mobile usability for in-store and delivery operations.
Developed barcoding functionality automating inventory and asset management.
Enhanced applications with modern frameworks, improving speed and reliability.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
zBestListings.com specializes in bulk data services used to automate marketing to other websites using a single feed from yours.  In May of 2015, zBestListings was renamed and incorporated as zBest Data Technologies, LLC.

Our services include:

-Syndication to over 200 sites such as Zillow and Trulia and Yahoo
-Access to paid submission sites such as    Apartments.com, Rentals.com, and Rent.com
-Ability to translate all XML Formats including Zillow, Trulia, RETS and MITS
-Custom Xml Feeds or data tranfers 
-Analytics for ROI 
-Listing Verification for Syndication
-Instant RSS feeds

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
TAPSYS 
C#.NET Winform Application that completely automated the process of issuing and underwriting insurances quotes, beginning with the initial call from the customer to the ongoing management of issued contracts and payments.  This was the first process to successfully reduce the quoting process from over 2 weeks to just under 10 minutes.

company.name: TAPCO Insurance Underwriters,(a Division of BB&T)

positions.title: Applications Architect and Programmer
positions.description:
Environmental HARP Database  
ASP.NET / C#.NET Application used to assist us in meeting OSHA Air Quality Requirements for our employees. 

SOA Training  
Received training in SOA and MS Service Factory Development Tools to aid in company merger of Lehigh and Hanson.  

Web Time Entry  
ASP.NET / C#.NET application used by administrative staff to manage and approve electronic employee time cards for submission to JD Edwards for final payroll processing

VURV  
Nicknamed our Company’s “Mini-Monster.com”, this posts new openings to our internal employees before making them available to people out side of the company. 

Navigator - Appraisal and Merit System 
An ASP.net / VB.NET Web Application that is used all the managers in North America to perform their annual reviews and appraisals.  

Navigator - Pensions and Retirement Benefits 
Classic ASP Web Application that is used by or Pension and Benefits Depart to manage payments and distribution of all employee pensions and benefits, including those who are retired or deceased.   

Navigator Data Feed 
Navigator was a supplemental system to the information stored in JD Edwards, which required regular updates to keep the 2 systems in Sync.   When the process began exceeding 8 hours, we I reduced the processing time to under 3 hours, and quickly resolved the problems seen by the end users.

TimeCentre Time Clocks  
The first step in our payroll process, managing over 250 plants across the United States to record the hours an employee has worked.  The times are automatically transferred into our Web Time Entry system for final approval and payroll processing.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Y2K Conversion
A huge undertaking for all banks, my primary job was to assist in recoding multiple applications and reports to accommodate the new 4 digit year.

Computer Telephony Integration (CTI) 
VB WinForm Application used by the Banking’s Customer Telephone Staff, this VB6 application supplied customer account information directly from the Hogan Mainframe.  
• Member of development team that created the application
• Provided ongoing support, fixes and enhancements to the system
• Added integrated MS Office forms for automatic prefill and creation of legal documents such as new accounts, money transfers, credit card application, and loan applications
• Added functionality to perform direct transfers via Western Union
• Reduced loading of account information from 48 seconds down to 6 seconds by taking repeated database calls and storing them in memory.

Automated Car Loan Application System 
One of the largest money makers for the bank, car loans were received from the dealer in a bidding process.  Statistically, the best bid out of the first 3 received got the loan.
• Developed VB 6 WinForm Application to interface with the mainframe and prefill the customer’s info if found.  Otherwise, data had to be manually entered. 
• Automatically retrieve credit score on customer
• Automatically approve or deny a load based upon the banks criteria
• Automatically return the results to the requesting dealerships

Loan Exception Reporting 
Partly for auditing purposes, the bank is required to maintain records of  liens and exceptions on the loans that it has.  These were reported by a series of Crystal and MS Access reports. 
• Created new reports and required by the internal customer
• Corrected problems or calculation found in existing reports
• Found over $2 million in untracked exceptions due to an improperly linked data table.

Data Warehousing Team 
Worked as auxilary member to the Data Warehousing Team.

positions.title: Owner and Developer
positions.description:
Maintenance Automation 
Developed, Marketed and Sold a CMMS Enterprise system aimed at meeting ISO and QS 9000 Certification requirements in the areas of Preventive Maintenance, Unscheduled Maintenance, Predictive Maintenance, Maintenance Inventory and Employee Time Billing.  Some of my customers included Welches, Legget-Myers Tobacco, and Tyco Plastics.

Monthly Writer and Contributor
Provided monthly articles to several national trade publications including Plant Safety and Maintenance, Plant Maintenance, and Plant Engineering & Maintenance.

positions.title: Quality Engineer and Color Specialist
positions.description:
A world leader in Automotive Manufacturing, Lear was a plastics injection molding  plant that produced the door panels for the Ford Explorer, F150 pickup, and Aerostar Van.
  
• Tracking and Management of incoming materials and Suppliers
• Management of all quality documents and QOS Manuals
• Training of auditors in quality control techniques such as SPC, Pareto chartings and histograms
• Preparation and approval for new part submissions to FORD which included testing, spec requirements, management approvals.
• Provide support and assistance to all teams in order to insure zero defects at the customer.
• Created MS Application database and reporting system to aid in quality tracking of test results and monthly QOS Reports

positions.title: Chemist / Quality Engineer and Assistant Lab Manager
positions.description:
Based in France, Carbone of America is in the powdered metal industry making carbon brushes for electrical motors that are used in application such as starters, windshield wipers and electric windows.  Producing these brushes incorporated a multitude of processes that included blending, welding, tamping, grinding, baking, and pilling.

Position:  Quality Engineer / Assistant Lab Manager

• Tracking and Management of incoming materials and Suppliers
• Management of all quality documents and QOS Manuals
• Training of auditors in quality control techniques such as SPC, Pareto chartings and histograms
• Preparation and approval for new part submissions to Ford, General Motors and Chrysler which included testing, spec requirements, management approvals.
• Manage the Chemical Test Lab when the Lab Manager was not able to be on site.
• Created MS Access application to aid our maintenance department in meeting ISO requirements for Preventive, Predictive, and Unscheduled maintenance.

Position:  Lab Chemist 

• Perform testing as required for quality assurance and new product development.  Methods included both physical, wet chemistry and Instrumentation.
• Instrumentation included: FTIR, Particle Analysis by Laser Diffraction, Sulfur Analysis, Inductive Coupled Plasma(ICP)
• Devised Test Method for ICP to replace Electrolysis.  This eliminated our backlog of over 80 samples per day, giving us more time to devote to new product testing.•Promoted to Quality Engineer in August 93.
• Created a Lab Database using dBase and Clipper.  This allowed us to create monthly graphs and reports that our engineering department used to help improve our products.

educations.fieldOfStudy: BS Physics, BS Chemistry, Minor Math

patents.title: zBest Property Manager(TM)
patents.description: zBest Property Manager™ is a platform specifically designed for the Real Estate Industry that greatly reduces the time for development.  With all the important functionality already built in, what remains is the theme and layout to customize the site to your look and branding. In addition, zBest Property Manager™ is customizable to fit your way of doing business with the ability to integrate with other applications such as CRM's and advertising platforms.
